name: Bjorn Stromberg
bio:
Bjorn Stromberg's entry into motorsport wasn't through the roar of engines but through the meticulous precision of engineering. After serving in the Swedish military police, specializing in high-security logistics, Bjorn transitioned his expertise to the high-stakes world of motorsport. Initially, he consulted for several rally teams, streamlining their security protocols and safeguarding sensitive equipment. 

His approach to security is proactive and comprehensive. Bjorn believes in anticipating threats before they materialize, employing a blend of advanced technology and human intelligence. He's known for his innovative security solutions, often incorporating unconventional methods to maintain the integrity of the team's operations. Bjorn is meticulous in his planning, often bordering on perfectionism, which has earned him both respect and occasional eye-rolls. He's highly valued for his ability to remain calm under pressure and his unwavering commitment to protecting his team's assets.

What sets Bjorn apart is his visionary approach. He's not just concerned with the immediate security risks; he's constantly thinking about the future, anticipating potential threats and developing strategies to mitigate them. This forward-thinking mindset has made him a sought-after security consultant in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave at the front
physical.description: Bjorn is a tall, imposing man with a strong build and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Insists on conducting a thorough background check on anyone new entering the paddock, even temporary staff.
Always carries a small notebook filled with security assessments and contingency plans.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms and military jargon, often requiring translation.
